posts.body_html: For the pink to be expressed outdoors, would cold nights be the trigger I wonder? Seeing how everything seems to redden up when the temperature drops during the fall and winter.

posts.body_html:
Sept 13, 2018 22:39:34 GMT -5 calen said:
Here is my humble little L42 showing some very prominent veins. I received this directly from Mike King as L14 - these two clones are synonymous. Definitely one that's going to need some maxroids to the dome (pitcher) if it's going to grow fast, but well worth it!
Two years late, but I was thinking those two looked too darn similar... That sure explains a lot! Out of curiosity, is there anything else that confirms the clones as synonymous besides the consistency in characteristics?

posts.body_html: Here is mine right now, it's really tall, like 2 and half feet tall. It's the tallest plant in my greenhouse. It's getting the pink throat but the nights here have been warm, even hot, enough to keep the AC going at night. So the cold nights are not necessary for the plant to develop the pink throat. I repot them each year, maybe the new peat help?
